name: agent-custom-setup
audience_feeling: The reader should feel that a messy personal agent setup can become a versioned, reviewable project without putting secrets into git and without depending on one chat session's memory.
promise: Version custom agent setups as reviewable modules and keep project state durable, so a fresh session can resume from the repository alone.

preferred_terms.module: a versioned custom agent setup package with its own config and notes
preferred_terms.registry: the index of modules with temporal metadata
preferred_terms.sanitized: secret values stay outside the repository
preferred_terms.projection: a checked-in reflection of state whose authority lives on GitHub issues

good_examples: Your advisor and judge wiring lives in one chat session today. This repository keeps it as a versioned module another session can install.
Secrets stay in gitignored .env files outside this repository; templates name the variables only.
bad_examples: A seamless AI-powered launcher platform that securely stores all your keys.
One repo to rule every agent setup forever.
